name: Booking Appointment and Schedule Booking Calendar – Bookingor
author: Bookingor.com

sections.description:
Bookingor is your all-in-one solution for handling appointments and bookings directly from your WordPress site. It streamlines your scheduling process, integrates seamlessly with popular woocommcerce payment gateways and ensures your business runs smoothly by keeping you organized. Whether you offer individual services or manage group bookings, Bookingor makes it easy for your clients to book their appointments online.

Key Features:

  • Customizable booking forms and appointment schedules
  • calendars UI Design with 30 days and Slider Calendar
  • Payment Woocommcerce integration for transactions
  • Mobile-friendly design, ensuring clients can book on any device
  • Flexible service and category management
  • Email notifications and reminders for bookings

Ideal for:
– Service-based businesses (salons, fitness centers, consulting, etc.)
– Event management companies
– Any business that requires efficient scheduling

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later license. You are free to modify, distribute, and use the plugin for personal or commercial purposes, provided you adhere to the license terms.

Support

For support or any issues, please visit our [support page] or contact us at Bookingor.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files:
    Upload the bookingor.zip file to your WordPress site via the “Plugins” menu or unzip the file and upload it to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  2. Activate the Plugin:
    Go to Plugins in your WordPress dashboard, find Bookingor, and click Activate.

  3. Configure Bookingor Settings:
    Once activated, navigate to the Bookingor menu in your WordPress admin panel to configure the plugin settings, add services, set up booking forms, and customize the booking experience for your customers.

Where can I get Bookingor docs?

https://bookingor.com/docs/
sections.faq:
How do I add a new service?

To add a new service, go to the Services section in the Bookingor dashboard, click on Add New Service, fill in the details (service name, duration, price, etc.), and save.

Can I book with payment Woocommcerce?

Yes! Bookingor supports woocommcerce payment Checkout. Simply create a product and match it with your preferred service in the service section.

Is Bookingor mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! Bookingor is designed with a responsive layout, ensuring that both you and your clients have an optimal experience on mobile devices.

Third-party Services

This plugin utilizes a third-party service, ipinfo.io, to auto-detect the user’s country based on their IP address. This feature is used to initialize country-specific settings, such as phone number input.
